clips.send: Deng Xiaoping Theory. 1982, 1987, 1992, 1997. Deng Xiaoping is called the chief architect of reform and opening up. 1982: he called for building “socialism with Chinese characteristics” — China should follow its own road, not copy others. 1987, 13th Party Congress: China is at the primary stage of socialism. Basic line: economic development as the central task, plus two basic points — keep the socialist road and Party leadership, and keep reforming and opening up. 1992: on a tour of the south (including Shenzhen), Deng, aged 87, said: “Development is the absolute principle.” Plans and markets are both just tools. 1997, 15th Party Congress: Deng Xiaoping Theory was made the Party’s guiding thought.

clips.send: Rural reform: the household contract responsibility system. from 1978. Before: villagers farmed together in communes and shared the harvest about equally — work hard or not, you got the same. 1978: farmers in Xiaogang Village (小岗村), Anhui, secretly divided the fields among families: each family would farm its own plot. The deal: “Hand in the state’s share, keep enough for the collective, and all the rest is ours.” The land still belongs to the collective; families contract it. Harvests jumped. The system spread nationwide, and village factories (township enterprises) sprang up.
